description: This file defines the StackedColumn class, which models a stacked column in a report header for the OrangeHRM system. It manages a collection of Column objects, allowing setting/getting of the name and children, and provides a method to serialize to an array.

classes.name: StackedColumn
classes.description: Represents a stacked column in a report header, containing multiple Column objects, with methods for management and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an array of Column objects as children.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the array of child Column objects.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets the collection of child Column objects, adding each via addChild.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a Column object to the children array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the object into an array structure, including name and children.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child Column objects.
